method.all_sample_policy: retain every sample without clipping; undefined macro is null, unranked
method.aihub_all: pool D01-D04 utterances before macro averaging
method.overall: equal mean of kspon-clean, kspon-other, aihub-all
method.ranking: ascending unrounded CER; competition ranks for exact ties
method.validation: 48 sample hashes, sealed input identity/order/reference, CER edit counts, normalized population equality, 56 published filtered scores and outlier counts
method.limitation: Descriptive sensitivity on these saved outputs; no uncertainty estimates or independent edit-distance recomputation.

common_nonempty_reference.policy: Exclude normalized empty references equally for every model and both variants; then compare CER > 1.0 exclusion versus retention with unchanged macro aggregation.
